metadata.title: Press: facts and contact | Apropos Magazine
metadata.description: Facts and press contact for Apropos Magazine, an independent, ad-free Danish culture publication. Find our publisher, responsible editor and areas of coverage.

text.Fakta, kontakt og logo til dig, der vil: Facts, contact details and logos for anyone covering Apropos Magazine.
text.Apropos Magazine er et uafhængigt dansk: Apropos Magazine is an independent Danish culture publication covering music, film, TV series, books, art, gaming and cultural life. It is free to read and carries no advertisements, native advertising or sponsored editorial content. Apropos Magazine is published by Apropos Creative ApS, with Frederik Emil Kragh as responsible editor.
text.Læs mere om Apropos og redaktionen ↗: Read more about Apropos and the editorial team ↗
text.Ingen annoncer, native advertising eller: No advertisements, native advertising or sponsored editorial content
text.Musik og koncerter. Film og tv-serier. B: Music and concerts. Film and TV series. Books, art and gaming. Apropos explores culture and the cultural life around it.
text.Her finder du Apropos’ logoer som SVG. Å: Apropos logos are available here as SVG files. Open your preferred version and save the file from your browser. Keep the logo's proportions unchanged.
text.Har du spørgsmål om Apropos, ønsker du e: Have a question about Apropos, need a comment or looking for material for a story? Email us with your publication, topic and deadline.
